audience: small businesses in the Netherlands that invoice in Invoice Office

useCases.title: Find an invoice for a period
useCases.text: List the sales invoices by creation date or document number. Open one for its totals and lines.

useCases.title: Find quotes without an invoice
useCases.text: List the quotes, then list the invoices to compare them.

useCases.title: Check overdue invoices
useCases.text: List the payment reminders sent for overdue invoices. Open the customer for the contact details.

useCases.title: Add a new customer
useCases.text: List the customers to check for a duplicate. Then create the customer account. Each call writes a new record.
